mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ /rgyun gyi tshogs skong mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī na mo na mā mi/bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi ska

tei:div.tei:p: mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ /rgyun gyi tshogs skong mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī na mo na mā mi/ bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi skabs su mchod skong rgyas pa mi lcogs pas tshogs skong dkyus 'gro bya ba dang*/ /tshogs brgya btang ba sogs la khyer bder mos na tshogs kyi dam rdzas su 'os pa ji ltar tshogs pa bsham/ phrin las tshul bzhin btang la bzlas pa dang gtor 'bul yan grub nas/ tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje khros ma yi: thugs nas rang byung yi ge ni: ram̐ spros me 'bar mi gtsang bsregs: yam̐ spros rlung byung bag chags gtor: kham̐ spros chu byung gnyis 'dzin sbyangs: bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal med dbus: oṃ las bde chen ka pā lar: āḥlas ye shes bdud rtsi che: hūm̐ gis 'dod yon cir yang 'char: trām̐ las mchod skong sgrub pa'i rdzas: hrīḥyis zag med bde skyed gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ bh+rūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrī: s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: sam̐ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: sarba pū dza sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: tshogs mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhengs shig 'og min gnas yul dur khrod nas: khros ma nag mo rigs bzhi'i dhā ki la: zhing sngags lhan skyes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: dam tshig tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gzhan yang rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha: chos skyong srung ma gter gyi bdag po kun: dam tshig tshogs kyi 'du bar spyan 'dren na: thugs rje thugs dam dbang gis da tshur gshegs: yul snang dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi zhing : thabs shes bza' btung dam tshig rdo rje'i rdzas: 'dod yon bde chen rnam 'gyur thams cad pa: mched lcam ye shes snying por byin phob cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra bha rā he sarba dhā ki nī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra e h+ye hi: dzñā na ā be sha ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ ma hā su kha e ā ral+li hoḥ tshogs dang pos mchod cing skong ba ni/

hūm̐: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga: rigs lnga yab yum mnyam par sbyor: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bskyil: 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam mang pos: chos dbyings rgyas par gang ba 'dis: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang : rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs mchog dang : rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig las: chags nyams 'gal dang ral ba dang : nyams dang 'dres shing skong ba sogs: 'phral dang yun gyi sgrib pa kun: gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshags na: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: dbyings kyi dgongs pa ma g.yel zhing : 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje'i 'jug pas ma btang zhig: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: khros 'khrugs rnam rtog ma mdzad cig: nyams chags thams cad dbyings su bskang : rtog sgrib bag chags rang sar grol: gzung 'dzin las 'das 'od gsal ngang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bar pa bshags pa 'bul ba ni/ hoḥ dgongs shig rdo rje phag mo yum: gzigs shig 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: zhal zas 'dod pa'i yon tan gter: dgyes mchod chen por bzhes su gsol: bdag cag 'khor ba thog med nas: tha ma da ltar thug gi bar: mi shes gti mug dbang du gyur: nyon mongs shugs drag gnyen po chung : bag med dbang gis dam dang 'gal: ma gus bslab pa khyad du bsad: le lo snyoms las che ba dang : grogs ngan rkyen gyis gzhan dbang la: brten nas rang bzhin sdig pa dang : bcas pa'i ltung ba char bzhin babs: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yi: dam las 'gal zhing nyams pa kun: snying nas 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: phyin chad legs par bsdam lags na: 'gyod bshags dang du bzhes nas kyang : mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces bshags shing yi ge brgya pa mang du bzla'o/ /tshogs tha ma bsgral mchod bya ba ni/

e yam̐ dz+wa la ram̐ sarba sha trūm̐ bigh+nān aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje khros ma dbyings nas bzhengs: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro gzi brjid bskyed: las kyi dhā ki bye ba'i tshogs: khros 'khrugs rngams pa'i pho nya spros: 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phrog pa'i dgra: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs pa'i bgegs: rnal 'byor byang chub bsgrub pa la: bar du gcod pa'i dam sri'i tshogs: khug cig phob cig rten la bcings: lha dang phrol la myos su chug: tshe bsod sgrub mchog rnams la stims: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs: phung po tshogs kyi 'khor lor gtubs: rngams brjid rol pa'i zhal du bzhes: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog kun: ka dag chen po'i klong du zlog: oṃ badz+ra bha rā he kro dhī kā li badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba shā trūn bigh+nān dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ mā ra ya rbad: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti sarba ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ zhes bstab bo/ slar yang phud gtor 'bul la thugs dam bskang ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na kā ma gu ṇa s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ: zhes pas skong rdzas spel la/ hūm̐ hrī: bskang ngo gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang : dus gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang : yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i thugs= dbyings yum rdo rje phag mo'i= bde chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i= don grub rin chen mkha'= sgra sgrogs pad+ma mkha'= sna tshogs las kyi mkha'= zhing skyes dpa' bo dpa' mo'i= las mdzad phra man mkha'= gang 'dul dam tshig mkha'= 'bum phrag dpa' bo mkha'= rgyud gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i= snang srid dag pa rab 'byams= snod bcud rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= nyer spyod kun bzang rol mos= 'dod yon bde chen rgyan gyis= dur khrod gsang ba'i mchod pas= sbyor sgrol brtul zhugs mchog gis= rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsis= dmar chen rak+ta'i rgya mtshos=

rmad byung sha khrag gtor mas= zag med 'dod 'byung tshogs kyis= rang byung 'od gsal zhun mes thugs dam bskang : gzhan yang mchod rdzas skong rdzas sgrub pa'i rdzas: ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: thugs dam gnyan po chos kyi dbyings su bskang : bdag cag dam tshig nyams chags bzod par bzhes: nad rims gdon bgegs mi mthun bar chad sol: tshe bsod dpal 'byor 'khor slob snyan grags spel: rdo rje gsang mchog lam gyi grogs mdzad nas: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol: zhes bskang zhing yig brgya brjod/ tshogs rdzas rnams brda'i 'bul len dang bcas nang gi sreg blugs kyis rol/ lhag ma bsdus la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: zhes pas byin brlab/ e ā ral+li hriṃ hriṃ pheṃ pheṃ: zhes mgron bkug la/ hūm̐: dbyings dang ye shes gnas yul bdag: las dang dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma: bka' nyan 'jig rten pho nya'i sde: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs rnams kun: phud la dgyes pa phud kyis mchod: lhag la dbang ba lhag mas bskang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: rnam bzhi'i las kun 'grub par mdzod: sarba dhā ki nī ma ma ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes dang bshal chus mchod/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ hoḥ bdag cag rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mched lcam gyis: gsang mchog mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i grong khyer du: longs spyod chen pos mchod cing bskangs pa'i mthus: bdag gzhan dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog: ces brjod/ de ni gter gzhung mchod skong las btus pa'o/ ༈ /yang tshogs mchod khri 'bum la sogs par de las kyang bsdu bar 'dod na/ thog mar gong smos rgyas pa tshar gcig song nas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma dag thams cad kun: ye shes me rlung chu yis bsregs gtor bkrus: ban+dha'i snod du dam tshig rdzas kyi bcud: ye shes sprin phung mkha' khyab 'phro bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ

hūm̐ḥ dbyings nas sku bskyod bla ma yi dam lha: rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro rab 'byams tshogs: dur khrod ma mo spyang zhon mched sde 'bum: thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ tshogs snod ban+dha chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam: tshogs kyi ngo bo sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: zag med ye shes rang bzhin lhun por spungs: kun tu dgyes tshim 'od zer rnam par 'phro: bza' bca' btung ba mchog gi dam tshig rdzas: gser gyi ri dang rol mtsho lta bur bskyil: thugs dang gnyan skong 'dod yon bsam mi khyab: gling bzhi mu khyud khor yug brdal ba 'di: bla ma yi dam tshogs la mchod par 'bul: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rab 'byams dgyes par bzhes: chos srung dam can mnyes pa'i phul gyur nasaḥ byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub char ltar phob: byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang : mchog dang thun mong phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sa pa ri bā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: oṃ badz+ra bha rā he kro dhī kā li badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma dhā ki nī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: ma bh+yo dzaḥs pa ri bā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes gter gzhung phrin las kyi gtor 'bul kha bsgyur ba dang lhag ma smon lam gong ltar byas pas 'grub bo/ /'di la nongs pa mchis na rtsa ba gsum la bshags shing dge bas rdo rje btsun mos rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'ang nye bar mkho ba'i yan lag tu pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyi rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen por bris pa dge legs 'phel// //
